title: Build a full social app without writing code
summary: A self-described non-coder from Multan says he built beates, a chat and music-video app, with Claude Code over 57 days and 317 hours.
agent_role: Claude Code wrote the app's code. The founder directed the product, worked on it for 317 hours and handled store submissions.
outcome: Author reports 57 days and 317 hours of building, with launch set for 5 November and the iPhone version submitted to the App Store.
what_they_did: A founder from Multan, Pakistan, who says he can't write code, used Claude Code to build beates. It is a phone app with chats, 24-hour statuses, photo-to-music videos and duets. He worked on it for 57 days and listed it on Google Play for pre-registration.
how_it_went: He reports 317 hours of work so far. The Android app is open for pre-registration and the iPhone version is awaiting App Store approval, with launch set for 5 November.
prompt: I can't code, but I want to build a phone app called [app name] that does [main features, e.g. chats, photo sharing, short music videos]. Act as my developer. First, write a short plan: the screens, the features for a first version, and the order to build them. Then build it step by step. Explain each step in plain words and tell me how to test it on my phone. Ask me before setting up any paid service, publishing to an app store, or making anything public.

curation.rationale: A non-coder building a full social and music-video app with Claude Code over 57 days is a genuine application. However, the post is mostly a launch promotion with little detail on how the agent was used.
